name: Drovane Station 46 Original
description: This listing is a gypcrete-pack hardness filter listed with throughput 487 litres an hour, operating temperature 70 degrees Celsius, feed salinity 81 parts per thousand. Its remaining stated figures are media service 160 hours, unit price set after acceptance, energy source thermally driven.
